content: Where a building undergoing major renovation, which is not a residential building or a mixeduse building, will have more than 10 parking spaces after the major renovation is completed (a) one of those parking spaces must have access to one electric vehicle charge point; and (b) cable routes for electric vehicle charge points must be installed in a minimum of one fifth of the total number of remaining parking spaces.
question: More than how many parking spaces must a non-residential or non-mixed-use building have after a major renovation to trigger the electric vehicle charge point requirements?
